description: A shell script for setting up and managing Docker-based deployment of the OpenClaw gateway, including configuration, sandbox setup, image building/pulling, permissions, and startup procedures.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr and exits with status 1.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in the system, exits if not.

methods.name: run_docker_build
methods.description: Builds a Docker image with BuildKit enabled.

methods.name: is_truthy_value
methods.description: Determines if a given value is considered true (1, true, yes, on).

methods.name: read_config_gateway_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from openclaw.json config file.

methods.name: read_env_gateway_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from an environment file.

methods.name: ensure_control_ui_allowed_origins
methods.description: Configures the allowed origins for the control UI if not already set.

methods.name: sync_gateway_mode_and_bind
methods.description: Sets the gateway mode to local and binds it according to configuration.

methods.name: run_prestart_gateway
methods.description: Runs a command in the gateway container with --rm and no dependencies.

methods.name: run_prestart_cli
methods.description: Runs a CLI command in the gateway container, avoiding shared network during setup.

methods.name: run_runtime_cli
methods.description: Runs a CLI command in the Docker compose environment with specified scope and dependencies mode.

methods.name: contains_disallowed_chars
methods.description: Checks if a string contains control characters like newline, carriage return, or tab.

methods.name: is_valid_timezone
methods.description: Verifies if a timezone string exists in /usr/share/zoneinfo.

methods.name: validate_mount_path_value
methods.description: Validates that a mount path is non-empty, contains no control characters, and no whitespace.

methods.name: validate_named_volume
methods.description: Validates that a volume name matches the pattern for named volumes.

methods.name: validate_mount_spec
methods.description: Validates the format of a mount specification string.

methods.name: upsert_env
methods.description: Updates or inserts environment variables into a file.
